issue_context.title: br: make some enhancements for checkpoint for backup/restore
comments:
> @Leavrth `“ Support --use-backupmeta-v2 when use checkpoint for backup. Currently to use less memory, we need to use backupmeta-v2 and it's better use checkpoint both.”` I think use-backupmeta-v2 is not a good parameter name. What's the major improvement in backupmeta-v2 and we may just highlight the improvement in the naming.

@tonyxuqqi This is an experimental feature that already exist in v5.
backupmetaV1 saves all the schema infos in the memory at first, and then flush them into the external storage. 
backupmetaV2 limits the memory usage, so the schema infos are saved in many blocks, whose size is at most 128 MiB. When the size of one block exceeds the limit, the block would be flushed into external storage. Therefore, the memory usage can be limited to a fixed size.
